optimization-iteration.rationale: Measure code layout and inlining tradeoff across Rust code-generation units; all samples remain release builds.
optimization-iteration.phase_basis: Historical and preceding per-game profiles show IPC/serialization/hash/validation allocations on measured path; candidate targets Rust runner code generation
